scenes.line1: Can you spot pipeline issues fast?
scenes.say: Can you spot pipeline issues before users do? How do you know your data is trustworthy?

scenes.label: Freshness
scenes.sub: Tracks when data was last updated.
scenes.say: Freshness tracks when your data was last updated. It's key to knowing if your pipeline is on time.
Data observability tracks four main metrics: freshness, volume, schema changes, and distribution.

scenes.title: Automated Alert
scenes.say: Automated checks can alert you if sales data isn't updated by 8am, or if row counts suddenly drop.

scenes.question: What does schema drift mean?
scenes.right: Schema drift means the structure changed unexpectedly—like a missing column.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: What does schema drift mean? It's not just out-of-date data. Schema drift means the data structure changed, like a missing or renamed column.
